lines.text: Many learners say: My brother is a high man.
Better: My brother is a tall man.
Use tall for people. Use high for things like walls.

data.wrong: My brother is a high man.
data.right: My brother is a tall man.
data.why: Use tall for people. Use high for things like walls.
